finalists.label: Pneumonia
finalists.why: Common symptoms and findings such as fever, cough, dyspnea, and bilateral diffuse parenchymal infiltration are well-explained by this candidate.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of M. pneumoniae-IgM titer and PCR positive for M. pneumoniae in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid provides specific evidence for Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia over the more general diagnosis of Pneumonia.
